localDoulas.name: Emily Arena
localDoulas.description: Emily Arena runs Sweet Pea Doula Services from her home base in Peoria as a DONA-certified birth doula. Her work covers the whole arc: prenatal education and labor preparation, hands-on support during labor, and postpartum guidance and emotional care once the baby is home. She is a one-woman practice that keeps its calendar small and its response time fast - the kind of doula you text and get a real answer from. She has been building out local classes and community workshops for expectant families, so new clients can plug into a room of other Peoria parents while they prepare.

localDoulas.name: Samantha Zillweger
localDoulas.credential: Birth doula, certified through the International Doula Institute
localDoulas.description: Samantha Zillweger is a Peoria-based birth doula who came to the work after her own home birth in 2020 and certified with the International Doula Institute in 2024. Her package is straightforward: two prenatal visits covering birth preferences, comfort measures and the 3 Rs of labor, continuous support on delivery day, and a postpartum visit for breastfeeding basics and newborn care. She publishes flat-rate pricing instead of making families negotiate, and she is explicit about her style - calm, faith-centered support that treats birth as a family event rather than a medical procedure.

localDoulas.name: Modern Mama Doula
localDoulas.credential: Certified birth & postpartum doula team, Lamaze-certified childbirth educators
localDoulas.practice: Modern Mama Doula and Placenta Encapsulation Services
localDoulas.description: Modern Mama is a valley doula team whose service list names Peoria directly alongside Glendale and Surprise, making them one of the few multi-doula practices that formally covers the northwest valley. The team brings certified birth and postpartum doulas, Spinning Babies-trained labor support, Lamaze-certified childbirth classes, placenta encapsulation and birth photography under one roof. Phoenix Magazine has named them Best Doula multiple years running. For Peoria families who want team backup - a guaranteed doula at every birth even when the primary is at another delivery - they are the practice built for it.
